description: Every gold question in this repo is phrased once, by the people who wrote the corpus profile. The hidden set is phrased by someone else. This suite re-asks questions whose answers we already know, in wordings we did not use, against IDENTICAL gold documents - so any drop against the source suite is a robustness failure and nothing else. Styles are labelled so a drop can be attributed: `colloquial` and `formal` change register, `terse` strips the question down to keywords, and `oblique` deliberately omits the canonical entity name, which is the wording that tests whether graph expansion degrades gracefully when exact entity matching finds no seed.
authored_by: human, paraphrased from the source suites; gold documents copied unchanged
